name: Snapmaker PLA SnapSpeed @U1 0.8 High Flow nozzle
filament_notes: Estimated 0.8 mm high-flow starting values, not manufacturer-calibrated. Flow ratio and pressure advance use this diameter's standard values times the material's 0.4 mm HF/standard ratio from snorca/main b1831e5dcb. Temperature uses the 0.4 mm HF-standard difference. Retraction and cooling remain diameter-specific. Volumetric speed ceiling is 3x the inherited non-HF value for this diameter: 20 x 3 = 60 mm^3/s. This is a configured ceiling, not measured nozzle throughput. Calibrate for your nozzle and filament.
